body.statement:
Let \({\tt fit}\) be a full-column-rank, unweighted \({\tt lm}\) fit with \(N_{\rm obs}\) fitted observations and model matrix \(X\).  In \({\tt sandwich}\) version \(3.1\text{-}3\),
\[
 {\tt sandwich::bread}({\tt fit})=N_{\rm obs}(X^{\mathsf T}X)^{-1}.
\]

attestation.note: Exact code lines transcribed from the pinned CRAN sandwich 3.1-3 source tarball; SHA-256 960006cf4fcbada936b43acd04ddd8c0d1255570f41dda046ce778873f546134. For a full-rank unweighted lm fit, summary.lm's unscaled covariance is the inverse Gram matrix and its model plus residual degrees of freedom equal the fitted observation count.
